editorial_review_row.content: NAGA is a Frankfurt-listed social trading platform scoring 6.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. CySEC + BaFin regulated. NAGA Autocopy is the core feature — copy top-ranked traders automatically. Real stock investing available alongside CFDs. 77% retail loss rate and wider spreads limit the score. Best for social trading enthusiasts who want a European-regulated alternative to eToro.
